author: Good Enough
description:
In early insane asylums, this was used as a form of “treatment,” where controlled electric currents were applied to trigger seizures in patients. Doctors believed it could help mental illness, despite the intense physical effects it caused. This was done based on the belief that it could "reset" the brain and cure mental illness. 

This video explores one of the most disturbing practices in medical history and what patients were forced to endure.
